jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer – Agentic AI
jobs.snippet: Build and own AI-powered agentic pipelines at Nearmap, a geospatial imagery company. Apply cutting-edge ML techniques to large-scale aerial and satellite imagery, enabling autonomous decision-making for urban planning, insurance, and infrastructure markets.

jobs.title: ML / AI Software Engineer, Electronic Warfare
jobs.snippet: Apply machine learning to electronic warfare applications at DroneShield, an AI-powered counter-drone technology company. Develop and deploy ML models for signal intelligence, threat detection, and real-time classification of drone threats in contested RF environments.

jobs.title: Data Business Analyst
jobs.snippet: Partner with Macquarie's data and technology teams to translate business requirements into data-driven solutions. Drive data governance, reporting frameworks, and analytics initiatives across Macquarie's banking and financial services divisions.

jobs.title: Junior Data & AI Solutions Business Analyst
jobs.snippet: Entry-level BA role supporting AI and data initiatives across Macquarie Group. Work with data engineers and AI architects to define requirements, document solutions, and facilitate delivery of enterprise AI and analytics platforms.

jobs.title: AI Native Platform Engineer
jobs.snippet: Join Macquarie's AI SDLC Developer Productivity and Enablement team as a junior AI platform engineer. Build and maintain AI-native development tools and platforms that accelerate software delivery cycles across Macquarie Group's global engineering teams.

jobs.title: AI Engineer – Technology Risk Management
jobs.snippet: Develop and deploy innovative AI solutions for technology risk management at Macquarie. Build models and AI systems that enhance risk detection, monitoring, and governance across Macquarie's global technology infrastructure.

jobs.title: Data and AI Enablement Analyst
jobs.snippet: Build Macquarie Group's data and AI capability through the AI Enablement Skilling team. Design and deliver training programs, toolkits, and frameworks that help Macquarie staff confidently use data and AI across banking, financial services, and advisory operations.

jobs.title: 2026 Technology (Cloud) Graduate Program
jobs.snippet: Accelerate your tech career in Westpac's Cloud Technology Graduate Program. Gain hands-on experience deploying cloud infrastructure, AI workloads, and MLOps pipelines supporting Australia's oldest bank. Two-year rotational program across Sydney and Melbourne.

jobs.title: Data Scientist – Health
jobs.snippet: Drive data science impact in Quantium's health analytics practice. Use predictive modelling, causal inference, and ML to generate actionable insights for healthcare providers, pharmaceutical companies, and government health agencies across Australia.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Scientist
jobs.snippet: Develop ML models for Neara's 3D digital twin platform powering utility infrastructure simulation. Apply computer vision, physics-informed ML, and geospatial modelling to help energy network operators prevent outages and plan grid upgrades.

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.snippet: Lead advanced analytics and ML model development at Sportsbet, Australia's leading online sports betting platform. Build models for customer personalisation, risk pricing, responsible gambling detection, and real-time product recommendation engines.

jobs.title: Data Engineer (6 months Fixed Term)
jobs.snippet: 6-month fixed-term data engineering role at ANZ Bank, designing and building data solutions that meet business and regulatory requirements. Work with modern data stack including cloud platforms, streaming pipelines, and data mesh architectures.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer, Internship – AUS Government
jobs.snippet: Internship deploying Palantir AIP and Gotham for Australian government agencies. Work directly with clients to deliver software solutions integrating AI into government decision-making workflows. 2026 graduates only; requires eligibility for Australian security clearance.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Software Engineer – AUS Government
jobs.snippet: Full-time FDSE role deploying Palantir AIP and Foundry for Australian defence and intelligence clients. Own technical implementation end-to-end, build tools on top of Palantir's AI operating system, and drive adoption across government agencies. Requires active Australian security clearance.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (AI)
jobs.snippet: Build AI-powered health products at Eucalyptus, a Sydney-based telehealth company. Design and implement scalable AI features across digital health platforms including Juniper, Pilot, and Kin. Work with LLMs, clinical AI, and ML-powered personalisation to improve patient outcomes at scale.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer – AI Foundations
jobs.snippet: Lead ML infrastructure and model development at Kraken, a global cryptocurrency exchange. Build the foundational AI and ML systems powering fraud detection, liquidity optimisation, and trading analytics for Australian and global users.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer – Data & AI
jobs.snippet: Senior data engineering role at MYOB building scalable data infrastructure for Australia's leading SME accounting platform. Design and maintain data pipelines, data lakehouse architecture, and feature stores powering AI and ML products used by 1M+ Australian businesses.

jobs.title: AI大模型方向实习生（XFuture Camp 2026）
jobs.snippet: 博世XFuture Camp 2026暑期实习计划，AI大模型方向。参与博世智能制造、智能出行与智能建筑业务中的大语言模型应用研发，探索边缘AI与工业大模型落地。要求连续实习6个月，苏州/上海均可，截止7月12日报名。

jobs.title: 大模型LLM推理算法实习生
jobs.snippet: AMD中国2026年秋季实习（7–12月），大模型LLM推理性能优化方向。负责在AMD GPU（RDNA/CDNA架构）上优化LLM推理框架（ROCm/vLLM），研究模型量化、投机采样等前沿推理加速技术，上海/北京均可。

jobs.title: 音频大模型算法工程师实习
jobs.snippet: 月之暗面Kimi团队招募音频大模型方向实习算法工程师，参与语音/音频基础模型预训练与后训练，探索音频理解与生成能力边界。适合熟悉深度学习、有音频或语音模型经验的在读硕/博生，北京/上海/深圳均可。

jobs.title: LLM后训练算法研究员
jobs.snippet: 阶跃星辰面向社招/应届生招募大语言模型后训练（Post-Training）方向算法研究员，负责SFT、RLHF、DPO等对齐技术研究与落地，优化Step系列大模型的指令遵循、推理能力与安全性。要求顶会经验或相关工业经验，上海/北京。

jobs.title: 大语言模型算法工程师实习（智能驾驶方向）
jobs.snippet: 蔚来汽车2026暑期实习，AI算法——大语言模型（LLM）在智能驾驶场景的应用研究，包括端到端自动驾驶语言模型、驾驶决策LLM、场景理解等方向。在蔚来AI实验室参与前沿技术研发，上海/合肥均可。

jobs.title: 三维视觉算法实习生
jobs.snippet: 地平线机器人2026暑期实习，三维视觉算法方向。参与自动驾驶3D感知算法研发（含BEV感知、3D目标检测、点云处理等），在J6/J6P车规级芯片上落地高性能三维视觉模型，与整车厂联合开发量产方案，北京/上海/南京均可。

jobs.title: 大模型算法工程师实习生
jobs.snippet: 好未来2026暑期实习，大模型算法工程师方向。参与教育领域专用大语言模型研发（学科知识推理、题目解析、个性化学习路径规划），探索AI辅助教学边界，为好未来九章大模型团队提供研究支持，北京总部。

jobs.title: 语音合成算法工程师实习
jobs.snippet: 作业帮2026暑期实习，语音合成（TTS）算法工程师方向。负责AI朗读、口语练习等教育场景下的语音合成模型研发，探索神经TTS在低延迟/高自然度场景的优化，熟悉HiFiGAN/VITS/Codec LM模型者优先，北京。

jobs.title: 大语言模型算法工程师实习
jobs.snippet: 猿辅导2026暑期实习，大语言模型算法工程师方向。参与数学/科学学科专用大模型研发，涵盖数学推理、解题过程生成与验证、知识图谱增强等前沿方向，为猿辅导AI辅导产品提供算法支持，北京总部。

jobs.title: 数据科学与大数据分析实习生

jobs.title: 大模型算法工程师实习生
jobs.snippet: 零一万物2026实习岗，大模型算法工程师方向。参与Yi系列大语言模型的预训练数据处理、模型结构改进与后训练优化，探索多模态大模型（Yi-VL）前沿方向，与李开复博士领导的研发团队协作，北京海淀。

jobs.title: AI产品经理实习生
jobs.snippet: 知乎2026暑期实习，AI产品经理方向。参与知乎AI功能（知乎直答、AI搜索增强等）的产品设计与迭代，结合大模型能力优化用户内容消费与创作体验，运用数据分析驱动AI产品决策，北京。
